title: Inheritance, overloads and dispatch
why: Function overloading (spec disambiguates by arg count), inheritance linearization, virtual/override and library calls exercise solang's own dispatcher and mangling scheme rather than solc's.
hints: Two overloads f(uint8) and f(uint256) — arg-count disambiguation in the spec.
Inherited state variables and overridden functions.
Multiple constructors (solang requires named constructors; solc 0.8 allows only one — asymmetry expected).
